spec.title: Setup: build Apache Calcite core at both #1003 revisions and run CoreQuidemTest (agg.iq)
spec.description: Setup for case J12 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-product-behaviour-20-additional-cases.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-pr-20/worktrees (J12-calcite-fix = f992e6c8fbc3712c6bd70096fb6b05da448b2cab, J12-calcite-parent = f2638b9f7dc878f3f109cbc59d1a6ae02d3d5696), builds calcite core (with -am: linq4j) with Maven 3.5.4 (the project's wrapper version; Maven 3.10 rejects a duplicate dependency in piglet/pom.xml) on JDK 8u512, through an https mirror of the pom's http 'central' repository (scripts/maven-settings-https-central.xml), into the cache's own m2. The first step is online, the rest offline. Runs CoreQuidemTest (every sql/*.iq script, agg.iq among them) on each side, then the landed agg.iq transplanted onto the parent, where it is expected to fail, then again offline on the fix. Core and linq4j jars go to .../artifacts with sha256, runtime classpaths and JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-product-behaviour-20-additional-cases-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: CoreQuidemTest passes on both sides' own trees; the transplanted agg.iq fails on the parent; the offline rerun passes
